facts.fact: Mali's Directorate of Pharmacy and Medicines reports that corrections applied at a 17-18 November 2026 workshop restored automatic data migration between DHIS2 and the OSPSANTE health-logistics system, deployed in 2014, with batch transfer of facility data starting on 19 November 2026.
